- Adding functionality to Vue frontends (both)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a micro-frontend tool in React for tagging parsed data with a Go backend and PostgreSQL database using AWS 
- Helped design system architecture for microservices supporting data parsing, storing & tagging
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Go (Programming Language) · React.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: R&D Engineer (DOE Q Clearance)
positions.description:
- Created visualization tool in MicroStrategy which linked with workforce dataset on a SQL Server, building all queries and relationships for the project
- Received the 2019 Distinguished Performance Award for Small Teams
- Increased accuracy and decreased run-time of evaporation ponds portion of model for the laboratory's effluent reclamation facility

positions.title: Environmental Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Updated the plant with RCRA and SPCC requirements and put plant back into compliance with EPA regulations, saving the company upwards of $37,500 per day in possible fines
- Worked closely with operators and plant personnel to complete tasks and improve LDAR plant documentation

positions.title: Research Team Leader
positions.description:
- Acted as team leader of seven students while focusing on conceptualization and initial research of PERCS
- Created reaction database, improved apparatus design for heat transfer coefficient collection, and saved team $500+
- Gave oral research presentation at the 2016 International Congress on Advances in Nuclear Power Plants in San Francisco

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Increased rate of successful synthesis of core-shell-shell metallic nanoparticles from 5% to 90%
- Improved spin-coating behavior of nanoparticles on glass & BiVO4 to 60% coverage from 5%
- Presented results at Duquesne University Symposium
